integrity: The Rota–Baxter identity is reduced directly to one scalar hypersurface equation, counted by elementary finite-field fibers, and the invertible locus is counted from an exact determinant factorization. A standalone checker independently replays the identity and counts in small finite fields.
scientific_limitations: Counts operators rather than automorphism-conjugacy classes.
Only the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra is treated.
Equivalent finite-field counts may exist under different terminology.
title: Exact finite-field census of Heisenberg Rota–Baxter operators
